subject: general
question: Which event marked the pivot moment in the extremist and moderate struggle during the Indian freedom struggle?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat Split**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Surat Split occurred in **1907** during the Indian National Congress session held in Surat.
 
• It marked a significant division between the **Moderates** and **Extremists** within the Indian National Congress.
 
• The Moderates, led by leaders like **Gopal Krishna Gokhale**, advocated constitutional methods of protest, while the Extremists, led by **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, demanded more radical measures for achieving independence.
 
• The split weakened the Indian National Congress and delayed the united struggle for independence for several years.
 
• The growing ideological differences, particularly over the **Swadeshi Movement** and boycott of British goods, were the primary reasons behind the split.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Moderates vs. Extremists:**

 
 
• Moderates believed in petitioning the British government for reforms and relied on peaceful negotiations.
 
• Extremists advocated direct action, including boycotts, protests, and promoting Swaraj (self-rule).
 
 
 
• **Swadeshi Movement:**
 
 
• Initiated as a response to the **Partition of Bengal** (1905), it promoted the use of Indian-made goods and boycott of British products.
 
• It became a cornerstone of Extremist ideology during the freedom struggle.
 
 
 
• **Partition of Bengal:**
 
 
• Announced in 1905 by Lord Curzon, it divided Bengal into East Bengal and West Bengal, allegedly for administrative efficiency.
 
• The move was widely opposed as it was perceived to be a strategy to divide Hindus and Muslims.
 
 
 
• **Impact of Surat Split:**
 
 
• The division within the Congress weakened the nationalist movement for some years.
 
• Unity was restored later during the Lucknow Pact of 1916, when Moderates and Extremists reunited to fight British rule.
